title: Generalizable Lithographic Hotspot Detection Using Asynchronous Meta-Learning with Only One Shot
problem: CNN-based lithographic hotspot detectors overfit and fail to generalize to unseen circuit layouts despite being trained on existing designs, limiting applicability across diverse design styles at the same technology node.
motivation: Layout printability is increasingly critical in advanced technology nodes, but deep learning hotspot detectors trained on one design cannot be reliably deployed to new designs without retraining, reducing their utility in multi-project design environments.
method: The method combines meta-learning (training a system to learn how to adapt quickly to new problems) with a multi-gate mixture-of-experts model (multiple specialized sub-networks with several decision gates routing inputs to the right expert) and asynchronous multi-task learning (where different components are trained independently rather than all at once). The CNN's feature detection (identifying hotspot indicators) and classification (deciding if it's a hotspot) components are updated separately, which allows them to specialize independently. A topology-based sampling strategy (selecting training examples based on circuit structure) guides the adaptation process, enabling the system to generalize to new designs using only one training layout clip.
key_novelty: This is the first meta-learning (learning how to quickly adapt to new problems) approach for lithographic hotspot detection, enabling rapid generalization to new circuit layouts from just one training sample through asynchronously trained multi-gate mixture-of-experts (multiple specialized sub-networks updated independently) that decouple feature detection and classification.
contributions: Few-shot meta-learning framework for generalizable CNN-based hotspot detection across diverse layouts.
Asynchronous multi-gate mixture-of-experts model decoupling feature extraction and classification.
Layout topology-based sampling strategy improving generalization stability to unseen designs.

metrics.accuracy: superior generalization on unseen new designs vs prior art

primary_theme: few-shot meta-learning for generalizable lithographic hotspot detection
